verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents an official CLI that exposes a broad slice of its API as terminal commands. It has a one-line install, defaults to sandbox with a `--prod` opt-in, and uses role-gated OAuth. It is explicitly positioned to power AI coding agents and serves as the foundation of AgentOS. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI's behavior beyond first-party docs and a probe confirming the docs page exists.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The Airwallex CLI lets you work with your Airwallex account directly from a command line.
Power AI coding agents — let agents that can run terminal commands (for example, Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex) operate against your account. This is also the foundation of Airwallex AgentOS.
Explore the API interactively — discover endpoints, preview requests, and inspect schemas before you commit to a full integration.
Connectors — the Airwallex CLI and the Airwallex AgentOS MCP server
